description: T-4274: table T on S!A1:C4 (Col 1,2,4; Other 10,20,40), C2 typed =A2*2 so the Calc column is filled; then delete_row 2 (the table's first data row). The question is the saved calculatedColumnFormula text in xl/tables/table1.xml of the cached recalculated workbook; sheet F scores FORMULATEXT of the shifted Calc cells (F!A1:A3), their SUM (F!A4), and FORMULATEXT/ISFORMULA of the first data row's Calc cell S!C2 through INDIRECT (F!A5:A6).
